items.message:
@Roth.genWronskian : {K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] → {σ : Type u_2} → {l : ℕ} → (Fin l → σ →₀ ℕ) → (Fin l → MvPolynomial σ K) → MvPolynomial σ K

def Roth.genWronskian.{u_1, u_2} : {K : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field K] → {σ : Type u_2} → {l : ℕ} → (Fin l → σ →₀ ℕ) → (Fin l → MvPolynomial σ K) → MvPolynomial σ K :=
fun {K} [Field K] {σ} {l} D φ ↦ (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv (D μ)) (φ ν)).det
generalized : (Fin 2 → ℕ →₀ ℕ) → (Fin 2 → MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ) → MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ

generalized : (Fin 0 → PEmpty.{u_1 + 1} →₀ ℕ) →
  (Fin 0 → MvPolynomial PEmpty.{u_1 + 1} ℤ) → MvPolynomial PEmpty.{u_1 + 1} ℤ

generalized : (Fin 2 → ULift.{u, 0} ℕ →₀ ℕ) →
  (Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (ULift.{u, 0} ℕ) ℤ) → MvPolynomial (ULift.{u, 0} ℕ) ℤ

generalized : (ULift.{w, 0} (Fin 2) → ULift.{u, 0} ℕ →₀ ℕ) →
  (ULift.{w, 0} (Fin 2) → MvPolynomial (ULift.{u, 0} ℕ) (ULift.{v, 0} ℤ)) →
    MvPolynomial (ULift.{u, 0} ℕ) (ULift.{v, 0} ℤ)
fun P d ↦ P.coeff d : MvPolynomial ℕ ℤ → (ℕ →₀ ℕ) → ℤ
